name: Tata Scholarship at Cornell University
eligibility_criteria: Must be an Indian citizen, accepted for undergraduate admission to Cornell, and eligible for need-based financial aid.
award_value: Full tuition and living expenses for up to 8 semesters.

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: International student, nominated by their school. Outstanding academic achievement and creativity. Recognized as leaders within their school.
award_value: Tuition, books, incidental fees, and full residence support for 4 years.

name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Students from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their own countries for political or financial reasons. Must hold an offer from Oxford.
award_value: Course fees, a grant for living costs, and one return air fare per year.

name: Karsh International Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: International students demonstrating strong academic preparation and documented need for financial aid.
award_value: Full tuition, room and board, mandatory fees, demonstrated need, plus 3 summers of funding for research/internships.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
eligibility_criteria: Indian students enrolled in 1st year of UG courses. Must have passed Class 12 with minimum 60%. Household income < Rs. 15 Lakh.
award_value: Up to Rs. 2 Lakhs over the duration of the degree.

name: Holmes Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a transfer student with a minimum 3.5 GPA and a minimum of 12 semester hours prior to enrolling at Trevecca.

name: Army ROTC Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is competitive.

name: Arnold Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon academic excellence, leadership, and community involvement.

name: Pamplin Scholars Program
eligibility_criteria: Program consists of two awards: the Leadership Award and the Scholar Award. Leadership Award applicant must be a senior enrolled in a Virginia public high school and must have a minimum 3.75 GPA and rank in top 5% of class. One Leadership Award recipient will be selected to receive the Scholar Award.

name: Aura E. Severinghaus Award
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an underrepresented minority student who is in their senior year at the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Columbia University. Applicant must have demonstrated outstanding academic achievement, leadership, and community service.

name: Binkley-Stephenson Award
eligibility_criteria: Awarded for the best scholarly article published in the Journal of American History during the preceding calendar year (March, June, September, December issues).

name: Music Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon audition and interview. Band and choral scholarships are available to music and non-music majors.

name: Chemistry and Biochemistry Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon academic performance, SAT or ACT scores, leadership, extracurricular involvement, and community service.

name: Bonner Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must rank in top two-fifths of class, demonstrate commitment to community service, and meet specific academic and financial need criteria.

name: Mary R. Hardwick Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon financial need, overall academic standing, and applicant's required essay.

name: Cochran-McDonald Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be employed by a Cochran-family-operated McDonald's restaurant and have a good work record and a recommendation from the manager. Financial need may be considered. Preference is given to freshmen and applicants demonstrating academic excellence.

name: Prestige Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a U.S. Citizen and must have admission to the Columbus campus for autumn quarter after high school graduation. Applicant must meet two out of three of the following requirements: top 20% class rank, 3.2 GPA on a 4.0 scale, 23 ACT/1070 SAT. Applicant must demonstrate leadership experience and a record of extracurricular activities and service. One or more of the following additional criteria will be considered: First-generation college attendance, race and ethnic background, socioeconomic factors, state and county of residence.

name: Joel W. Collins Sr. Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum cumulative 2.5 GPA.

name: John A. Baker Memorial Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a 2.0 GPA and a strong desire to complete degree. Selection based on financial need.

name: Honor Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is by invitation upon admission. Applicant must have a minimum 3.3 GPA and minimum composite ACT score of 26 (combined SAT Reasoning score of 1170).

name: Past President Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum 3.2 GPA and demonstrate contributions to the college community. Selection is based upon financial need, leadership ability, and character.

name: Theta Delta Chi Educational Foundation Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an active member in good standing at any active charge or colony in the Fraternity who is a junior or senior in college. Minimum 3.0 GPA required.

name: William H. Dunlap Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have lost one or both parents, either by death, desertion, or other conditions, which prevent such students from having normal parental care.

name: Tau Beta PI/SAE Engineering Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a 3.75 GPA and be accepted into an ABET accredited program. Applicant must submit essay and transcripts. Selection is based upon standardized test scores.

name: North Jersey Regional Development Council Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon financial need.

name: International Students Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a student whose parents are not employed by the Seventh-day Adventist church and who enroll under a student visa status matriculated in a degree program. Applicants must be accepted as degree candidates and enroll for a minimum of 12 credits each semester.

name: Charles W. and Alice P. Davies Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a full-time freshman or sophomore resident of Fremont or Mills counties in Iowa. Selection is based upon class rank, GPA, ACT score, and financial need.

name: Community College Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a transfer and a have a minimum 3.0 GPA.

name: Helen I. and Rodney E. Nern Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must demonstrate financial need and be enrolled at Purdue University Fort Wayne. Minimum 3.0 GPA required of continuing students. FAFSA required of all applicants.

name: Scholarship Incentive
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum 2.5 GPA, demonstrate financial need, and be enrolled full-time in an institution in Delaware or Pennsylvania. Applicants from other states may be considered if pursuing a major that is not offered in Delaware.

name: Summer Scholarship in Epidemiology
eligibility_criteria: Award is to increase skills in epidemiology for M.D.'s currently working in cystic fibroses.

name: Pay it Forward Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a graduate of Clarion-Limestone High School or Keystone Oaks High School who clearly understands and demonstrates the concept of Pay it Forward. Applicant must have a minimum 2.75 secondary school GPA and minimum combined SAT Reasoning score of 900 (composite ACT score of 19). Essay required.

name: Bernard Ramsey Honors Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must rank in the top 5% of high school class and have a minimum combined SAT score of 1400 (composite ACT score of 31). Award is granted to Foundation Fellowship finalists who do not receive the fellowship. Applicant must have 3.7 GPA.

name: Friends of IPFW Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a high school graduate who ranks in top 30% of secondary school class, has a minimum combined SAT score of 1650 (composite ACT score of 24), and has been admitted to the university.

name: Foundation Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a member of a state, county, provincial, municipal, community, industrial, or federal fire department, must be interested in furthering his or her education in the fire sciences, and must submit application and statement of need. Selection is based upon need, desire, and initiative. Must be a member for two years of an emergency service organization (fire or emergency medical service).

name: Piedmont Incentive Grant
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must demonstrate financial need.

name: Athletic Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Description not available

name: Elon College Fellows Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must complete essay and interview if selected. Selection is based upon SAT Reasoning or ACT scores, GPA, and high school curriculum.

name: Raymond L. Boozer Endowed Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a resident of Lexington County, S.C. and have a minimum cumulative 2.5 GPA.

name: Eleanor Tillquist Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a Ventura County resident who is a female, a student at Ventura College, with a minimum 3.0 GPA. Applicant must be interested in a medical related degree and demonstrate financial need and community service.

name: Polly H. and Walter L. Lowry Memorial Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum cumulative 2.5 GPA.

name: Lincoln Food Service Grant
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a member of the American School Food Service Association (ASFSA).

name: Alumni Association Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a Canadian citizen or landed immigrant with a minimum grade average of 88%. Selection is based upon academic merit, academic promise, and contribution to school or community life. Award is in Canadian dollars.

name: Mary Feindt Forum for Women in Surveying Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must submit six copies of application, proof of membership in ACSM, a brief statement describing educational objectives, future plans of study or research, professional activities, and financial need, at least three letters of recommendation, and official transcript.

name: IEHA Education Foundation Scholarship Award
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an IEHA member.

name: Founders Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum cumulative high school GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale and a SAT Reasoning composite score of 1700 (ACT equivalent score of 25).

name: Easterm States Exposition Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Preference is given to applicant who has participated in the Eastern States Exposition.

name: Flight Safety International Instrument Refresher Course Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a Whirly-Girl in good standing and possess an Instrument Rating Helicopter to apply. Course consists of 12 hours of academic training, six hours of simulator instruction and will be conducted at the Flight Safety Learning Center in Hurst, Texas.

name: Canadian Tuition Grant
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a Canadian student who enrolls full-time.

name: Missionary Grant
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a dependent of a missionary.

name: R. Paul Nelson Full Tuition Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon GPA and SAT or ACT scores.

name: Provost's Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon academic qualifications, including ACT/SAT I scores, class rank, and recalculated GPA.

name: Economics Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be enrolled at the University of Missouri at Columbia.

name: Elizabeth and James McKenzie Andrews Bursary
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an Alberta, Canada resident and have a minimum 2.6 GPA. Applicant must demonstrate academic merit and financial need. Award is in Canadian dollars.

name: Leaders Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum high school GPA of 2.8 and a minimum combined SAT Reasoning score of 920 (composite ACT score of 19).

name: Atlanta Press Club Journalism Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must demonstrate interest in journalism, be attending a school in Georgia, and demonstrate financial need. Selection is also based upon academic performance. Two awards available for both broadcast and print journalism applicants.

name: Lois Virginia Singletary Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum 3.0 GPA and show promise of academic success and leadership.

name: D.W. Colvard Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a North Carolina resident, have a minimum 3.85 GPA, and demonstrate leadership and community and school service. Interview required of finalists.

name: Provost Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a GPA between 3.25 and 3.65 and a SAT Reasoning score between 950 and 1100 (composite ACT score of 23).

name: Shawnee State University Alumni Association Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum 3.0 GPA, be the child of a Shawnee State University alumnus/a, and a recent high school graduate.

name: Girl Scout Leadership Award
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a woman, be an active Girl Scout member, have a letter of recommendation from Girl Scout Leader, submit a copy of Girl Scout record, meet all admissions requirements, and demonstrate financial need. FAFSA is required.

name: James C. Basile Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a Ventura County Resident, demonstrate financial need, have a 3.0 GPA and be enrolled in a public college or university in California. Preference for students from schools in Simi Valley or Moorpark; or for Ventura County students who are physically or visually impaired; or for Ventura County students who have had one or both parents killed or disabled while engaged in services as a fire fighter or law enforcement provider.

name: Indiana University at Fort Wayne 25th Anniversary Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a new high school graduate and demonstrate superior academic achievement, leadership, or service within his or her school or community.

name: Arturo Schomburg Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must demonstrate promise in the areas of strong academic performance and leadership at Hampshire College and in the community.

name: Nursing Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be enrolled at the University of Missouri at Columbia.

name: Howard E. and Wilma J. Adkins Memorial Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum 3.2 GPA in engineering (2.8 overall), be at least 18 years old, and be a U.S. citizen. Preference is given to applicants residing or attending school in Wisconsin or Kentucky.

name: Mary Ann Reinert Nursing Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon description of career goals, volunteer and work experience, awards/honors, letters of recommendation, transcript, class rank, GPA, and financial need. Applicant must be enrolled full-time in an approved nursing or other health-related program and must be a resident in the Heartland Foundation service region.

name: Kansas All-State Academic Team Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be recognized as a member of the state's All-State Academic Team. Minimum 3.75 GPA required.

name: Academic Excellence Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a Wisconsin resident enrolled full-time at a U of Wisconsin campus, Wisconsin Tech Coll or independent Wisconsin institution. Applicant must have the highest GPA in his or her class.

name: Technical and Community College Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a student member of ASM International Foundation. Application information can be found through local ASM chapter.

name: Dean's Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum 3.3 GPA and a minimum composite ACT score of 25 (combined SAT Reasoning score of 1130).

name: Hopi Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an enrolled member of the Hopi Tribe. Applicant who is an entering freshman must rank in top tenth of class and have a minimum composite ACT score of 21 (combined SAT Reasoning score of 930). Undergraduate applicants must have a minimum 2.5 GPA.

name: Lou Henry Hoover Girl Scout Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must demonstrate involvement in the Girl Scout Movement. Selection is based upon financial need.

name: John Wallace Cathcart II Annual Memorial Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have a minimum cumulative 2.5 GPA.

name: Major Madison Bell Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a lineal descendant of worthy Confederates or collateral descendant who is a member of the Children of the Confederacy or the United Daughters of the Confederacy. Applicant must have at least a 3.0 GPA, be enrolled in an accredited college or university, and carry a minimum of 12 hours each semester. Applicant must be prepared to pass entrance examination of prospective college or university. Applicant must submit proof of Confederate Military Record, line of descent from Confederate ancestor, a letter of endorsement from sponsoring Chapter, a letter of recommendation, complete financial report, official transcripts, an essay on the significance of a southern heritage, and a wallet-size photo. Original and four copies of the application forms and five copies of all documents, certificates, and letters must be submitted to the Division Director of Education. All inquiries must include a self-addressed, stamped envelope.

name: Stanley D. Conklin Scholarship for Nurses
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must rank in the top two-fifths of class and have a minimum combined SAT Reasoning score of 1000.

name: Dana Christmas Scholarship for Heroism
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have been 21 or younger at the time of heroic act and be a NJ resident.

name: Senior Fellowship
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must have held a doctoral degree for seven years or more. Detailed proposal including a justification for conducting research in residence at the Smithsonian Institution is required.

name: Dean's Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Selection is based upon class rank, GPA, SAT or ACT scores, and advanced classes.

name: Bill and Lynn Stamm Kovach Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Entering freshman applicant must have a minimum 2.5 GPA and a minimum composite ACT score of 24. Undergraduate applicant must demonstrate potential for academic success and financial need.
